iti2:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ:
iti2:2.1: Ekadhammaṃ bhikkhave pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāya. Katamaṃ ekadhammaṃ? Dosaṃ bhikkhave ekadhammaṃ pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti2:3.1: Yena dosena duṭṭhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ dosaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti2:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||2||
